02 / In focusTINE UGRIN

BEHIND
THE PART.

A Slovenian actor.
A curiosity for different worlds.

Tine’s screen work includes the road-trip film Gepack, Martin Turk’s Don’t Forget to Breathe and the television series Gospod profesor. His work also extends to short films and theatre.
